description: Press a key or shortcut on the focused element, or on `ref` (focused first). Keys: Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, a, … Shortcuts join modifiers with +: Control+A, Control+C, Control+V, Shift+Tab, Control+Shift+ArrowLeft, ControlOrMeta+A (Cmd on macOS).

ref.description: Optional element ref to focus first.

name: press_key
